## Summary

Describe the user or contributor problem and the solution.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or maintenance

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks you ran. Include screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept file processing browser-local and did not add an upload or remote-processing fallback.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior and ran the relevant checks.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check` successfully, or explained why a check is not applicable.
- [ ] I updated public documentation when behavior or limitations changed.
- [ ] I considered accessibility, localization, privacy, memory use, and browser compatibility where relevant.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, private files, user data, internal plans, or security-sensitive operational details.
